description: This JavaScript file defines a React-like component for a weather details page, including UI layout, state management, data fetching, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: updateClock
methods.description: Updates the displayed time text to the current local time.

methods.name: buildDisplays
methods.description: Constructs all display elements from the current weather and forecast data.

methods.name: iconPathFor
methods.description: Returns the file path for a given weather icon key.

methods.name: safeVal
methods.description: Safely formats a value with an optional suffix, or returns a placeholder if invalid.

methods.name: formatUpdated
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp into a formatted time string.

methods.name: formatDateLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for a date, such as 'Today', 'Tomorrow', or weekday name.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches current weather and forecast data for the selected location.

methods.name: onTopAction
methods.description: Handles actions from the top bar, such as refresh or toggling units.

methods.name: onBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the main page.

methods.name: onHourSelect
methods.description: Updates the selected hourly forecast item.

methods.name: onStripNavigate
methods.description: Handles navigation commands for the hourly forecast strip.

methods.name: onDaySelect
methods.description: Updates the selected daily forecast item.

methods.name: onDayStripNavigate
methods.description: Handles navigation commands for the daily forecast strip.

methods.name: applyFocus
methods.description: Applies focus to the currently active forecast strip.

methods.name: focusHour
methods.description: Sets focus to the hourly forecast strip.

methods.name: focusDay
methods.description: Sets focus to the daily forecast strip.
